question: What rules and numbers do the in-round progression (field upgrade) graphs, the remaining gadget graphs and the AI graphs hold?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/gadgets-perks-ai.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Passive upgrades (period / effect duration): low profile 1.0 / 1.1 s, stance flak 1.0 / 1.1 s, mechanized infantry 2.0 / 2.1 s, vehicle health plus 2.0 / 2.0 s, enhanced filtering every 0.333 s.
Active Medic: 7 m radius, crate-healing and ammo effects of 1.1 s, plus a 10 s self buff. Active Attack: 10 m squad radius, ends after 4.9 s. Active Repair and Anti-Repair: 10 s.
Combat High: kills within 5 s of each other raise a stack from 0 to 5; each stack applies `Healing_CombatHigh` with parameter 0.1. Repeatable Reward stacks to 4.

Mortar fire support: a ranging shot, then volleys; shells spawn 300 above the target with vertical velocity -100, landing in a random disc of `Mortar_DispersionRadius`; `FireSupportActive` multiplies shell count by `Artillery_IncreaseShellCountPerVolley`.
Sniper decoy: every 2 s applies an anti-glint effect (2.1 s) within 5 m; fires a fake effect every 1.5 to 6 s at random.
AI health ping: starts below 95 health and clears at 100; a squad leader counts as recently damaged for 2.0 s.
Sabotage timings repeat L4029 (29 s weapon disable, 26 s sabotaged).

inference: The timer prologue (`9a39505a` and related) is read as a periodic tick; it is consistent across 12 graphs.
Spot-effect durations are taken as argument 7 of an unnamed native call, by analogy with the perimeter alarm.
unresolved: Friend or enemy filters in anti-repair and gadget awareness are lost where a branch target equals the next line.
Improved targeting, mechanized infantry lock, the battle royale progression weapon graph, PTKM-1R targeting and the breaching dart are unreadable or weak.
The first numeric parameters of the spawn calls (57.6, 200, 5) have no identified meaning.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: In-round progression and remaining gadget graphs read: passive upgrades re-apply their effect on a timer with duration = period + 0.1, Active Medic uses a 7 m radius, Active Attack ends after 4.9 s, Combat High stacks to 5 on kills within 5 s, and the mortar call-in spawns shells 300 above the target
leads.summary: All 59 listings were read. Passive upgrades re-apply an effect on a timer whose duration is the period plus 0.1, so it never lapses. Active Medic heals and resupplies within 7 m; Active Attack ends after 4.9 s; Combat High raises a stack (to 5) for kills within 5 s of each other; Repeatable Reward stacks to 4. The mortar call-in spawns shells 300 above the target inside a dispersion radius. AI health ping starts below 95 health. 11 raw-offset checks matched.
